text:
mira (Marketing): Quick sync — we need a tight benchmark narrative for the NBD mini-launch. Goal: 3 microcharts, a single-phrase hero for the card, and inbound triage. Keep claims conservative.

cal (Data): Proposed visuals:
1) engagement % vs p95 latency (line with points)
2) token $ per 1k by batch & quant (small bar cluster)
3) p99 vs retry cost (area with marker)

noah (Growth): For routing: single dropdown on demo form: Speed | Cost | Reliability. Map to perf demo / ROI calc / SLA consult. Add utm=priority.

jin (Design): Card hero needs <90 chars. I'll make 2 comps and a subtle GIF (p95 shift). Sizes: 1200x628 + 1024x512 slide.

alexa (Product): Data extract (anonymized POC):
```
baseline: p95 340ms, tokens/$ = 0.024
optimized: p95 72ms, tokens/$ = 0.018
engagement lift: +19% task completion
est savings: ~22% per 1M tokens
```

mira (Marketing): Draft one-line hooks tied to visuals:
- Chart1: "Tighten p95 -> ~19% more task success (customer POC)"
- Chart2: "Batching + quant = predictable token $ savings"
- Chart3: "Lower p99 to avoid retries and hidden costs"

noah (Growth): CTA split: paid social -> "Schedule a perf demo"; organic -> "Try our ROI calculator". A/B both hero variants.

jin (Design): I'll annotate three decision anchors: "speed-first", "balanced", "cost-first" and add a tiny footnote for assumptions.

cal (Data): Uploading CSV + sample fig. assets-bot will confirm.

assets-bot: Uploaded /benchmarks/pocN_summary.csv (sha256: f2d3b7...)

alexa (Product): Legal note: use "~" qualifiers and include measurement assumptions (prompt length, model family, quant mode) in slide footers.

mira (Marketing): Final deliverables: chart PNGs, social card A/B, GIF subtle/bold, modal copy + routing. Everyone drop final files by 1887654389 (EOD). I'll assemble the launch thread and webinar invite. Thanks! :rocket:
